extracted.intended_audience: readers and commenters on The Hindu website
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and access rules for posting comments on The Hindu news articles (language, civility, account/subscription requirements and platform details).

rubrics_metrics.name: Language and sentence form
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments have to be in English, and in full sentences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submitters must write comments in English and use full sentences (no shorthand/fragments). No examples or further elaboration provided on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: No abusive or personal content
rubrics_metrics.description: They cannot be abusive or personal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users are instructed to avoid abusive or personal remarks when commenting; the page also directs readers to 'please abide by our community guidelines for posting your comments' for full behavioural rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obey community guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Please abide by our community guidelines for posting your comments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site refers commenters to its broader community guidelines (linked) which presumably expand on acceptable behaviour, moderation and removal policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration/login required to comment
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are already a registered user of The Hindu and logged in, you may continue to engage with our articles. If you do not have an account please register and login to post comments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comments require a registered/logged-in account; users who lack an account are asked to register and log in before posting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commenting platform and access to past comments
rubrics_metrics.description: We have migrated to a new commenting platform. Users can access their older comments by logging into their accounts on Vuukle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page notes a migration to a new commenting platform (Vuukle) and explains that older comments remain accessible via login; no further technical details provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription / sign-in affects commenting
rubrics_metrics.description: Sign in to unlock member-only benefits! Access to comment on every story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site highlights member-only benefits including the ability to comment on every story; non-subscribers have limited free access ('Access 10 free stories every month') which may limit commenting privileges.
